goal: Implement Goal Satisfaction Evidence Graph mapping criteria to verified artifacts, and enforce Campaign Drift Detector against North Star deviation.
hypothesis: Graph-based acceptance criteria verification eliminates unverified goal completion claims, and lexical-semantic drift checking filters out irrelevant autonomous backlog drift.
why_now: Addresses Section 50-55 requirements for autonomous goal governance.
scope: Evidence graph verification, goal evolution artifact preservation, drift detector scoring
acceptance_criteria: All criteria mapped to valid artifacts; drift detector rejects off-mission tasks; goal evolution preserves valid prior work.
falsification_criteria: Goal satisfied with missing criterion artifact, or off-mission task cleared.
